narrative: Driver-based revenue for 3.52M billable units at a blended ARPU of GBP 14.20: opening units + gross adds − churn = closing units, × ARPU, plus CDR usage and one-off. Monthly unit churn is 0.95% against 0.90% in the budget. Legacy voice falls 28% a year ahead of the switch-off; PhoneLine+ adds 9.4k lines a month.

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.

signals.title: FY2025 results: revenue £645.8m, adjusted EBITDA £141.7m
signals.excerpt: Gross profit £348.2m (54%), recurring revenue £572.0m. Germany gross profit +197% to £78.4m; Gamma Business GP −2%; Enterprise GP flat.
